runs.name: Synopsys, Inc.; Nasdaq SNPS, Delaware, 10-K filer; electronic design automation software and semiconductor IP; Ansys bought July 2025 for cash and stock
runs.box: TOO HARD (NATURE) AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Run at the operator's word ("re run all under v5", the names still carrying v4.1 bands), interactive dispatch under the canonical brief, three analysts in parallel (ASML, PLTR, SNPS), lock held by the main session; the brief's one departure is the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25. Price **$430.14** (2026-10-23, aggregator, flagged) x **191,636,646 shares** (one class, 10-Q cover `0000883241-26-000025`) = cap **$82,431M**; sovereign **5.33%** (Treasury 30-year, 2026-10-23). Q1 IN, close (Design Automation with Ansys deciding at 76% of three years of segment profit; revenue up every year since 2005 on ratable contracts; backlog $11.4B; 10-K `0000883241-25-000028`). Q2 TOO HARD (NATURE): a two-firm design-tool field whose product must be re-invented every year (updates "integral to maintaining the utility of the software licenses"; research 33% to 36% of revenue FY2016 to FY2025); which supplier holds its margin through the AI and multi-chip generations against Cadence, Siemens, customers' own tools and state-funded Chinese rivals is not a forecast insiders would write down; export rules the filer "cannot forecast". Evidence the other way recorded: Design Automation margin 37% to 42% (45% in FY2026 so far). Design IP profit down 43% in FY2025. Competitors (own filings, whole span): revenue growth SNPS 12.3%, CDNS 12.6%, ANSS 12.5% a year; owner-cash margin 14.9%, 20.2%, 24.2%; Siemens EDA and the Chinese suppliers not filers. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash $1,054M, $1,143M, $950M, $592M, $456M (FY2021 to FY2025), mean $839M; combined with Ansys, before interest, after tax $1,335M, declining 5.6% a year; range **$50.01 to $97.11 a share all-equity** (central, the combined averages, purchases left out: a confessed CONVENTION of the run), $65.61 to $102.59 equity-only; fair price **$25.28 all-equity** ($46.19 equity-only); no case earns the floor at the price. Facts after the stop: stock pay 59% of FY2025 operating cash; owner cash down from $1,143M to $456M while revenue rose 39%; about $35B paid for Ansys; tangible equity about -$11B; contract assets up nearly tenfold since FY2018; net debt $6.43B; FY2026 buybacks at $395 to $443 with no stated price; three securities class actions and three derivative suits over the Design IP disclosures; a 37.3% non-GAAP margin featured in the proxy against 13.0% GAAP, pay tied to it. Tooling defect reported: `tools/run.py` labels "Acquisitions, net of cash acquired" as purchases of intangibles, and its D&A variant deducts acquired-intangible amortization as depreciation. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; four pathspec commits, own paths only; 53 ids, no slip (the analyst's check). Contamination declared: a `.gitignore` line naming an earlier SNPS fetcher (not opened), other runs' commit subjects, `git status` names; none used. Position note filled at the fold: not held. No alert (closed before Q7); the v4.1 bands SNPS-rerun-band and SNPS-floor-band retired by this fold.
runs.narr: TOO HARD (NATURE) at Q2: a design-tool duopoly that must re-invent its product every year, and whose next-generation winner no insider would forecast. Computation only: range $50.01 to $97.11 all-equity vs $430.14, fair $25.28. Owner cash fell by more than half from FY2022 to FY2025 while revenue rose 39%; stock pay was 59% of FY2025 operating cash. A run.py defect reported: acquisitions read as intangible purchases.
